nodes.description: Owner address state variable in Owned; set in constructor from msg.sender and used by onlyOwner access control.

Mapping of account balances; written by transfer/transferFrom using safeAdd/safeSub.
Nested allowance mapping; written by approve/approveAndCall and decremented in transferFrom.
SafeMath addition helper performing c = a + b with a require check on the result.
SafeMath subtraction helper performing require(b <= a) then c = a - b.
SafeMath multiplication helper performing c = a * b with a partial overflow check.
SafeMath division helper performing require(b > 0) then c = a / b.
Owned contract constructor that sets owner = msg.sender.
Owner-only function that stages newOwner; restricted by the onlyOwner modifier.
Completes ownership transfer; requires msg.sender == newOwner then moves owner and zeros newOwner.
Token constructor initializing metadata, total supply and pre-allocating the supply to the deployer address.
Returns _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)].
View function returning balances[tokenOwner].
ERC20 transfer; subtracts from balances[msg.sender] and adds to balances[to] using SafeMath.
Sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens and emits Approval.
Moves tokens from 'from' to 'to', decrementing both the balance and the caller's allowance.
View function returning allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
Sets allowance and then invokes spender.receiveApproval, making an external call to an attacker-controlled address.
Payable fallback function that unconditionally reverts, rejecting plain ETH transfers.
Owner-only rescue function executing ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) on an arbitrary token address.
msg.sender used in Owned constructor and the onlyOwner/newOwner authentication checks.
msg.sender used as the debited account index in transfer.
msg.sender used as the allowance owner index in approve.
msg.sender used as the spender index when decrementing allowed[from][msg.sender] in transferFrom.
msg.sender whose allowance write precedes the external receiveApproval call in approveAndCall.
Arithmetic addition relying on require(c >= a) checks; flagged arithmetic for overflow semantics.
Arithmetic subtraction relying on require(b <= a) to prevent underflow.
Arithmetic multiplication with a partial overflow guard (a == 0 || c / a == b).
Arithmetic division guarded only by require(b > 0).
External call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(...) after allowance state change; reentrancy vector.
External call to an arbitrary token contract ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens).
Unconditional revert() in the payable fallback, blocking all direct ETH value transfers.
